core_differentiator: Designs systems rather than merely implementing features. Emphasizes measurable optimization, architecture decisions, AI integration, performance engineering, and continuous improvement.

professional_profile.note: Source: Application_Differentiators_and_Professional_Profile.pdf. Use these to shape the narrative/voice of CVs and cover letters — they describe how Jacqueline works, not new hard skills.

differentiators.title: Validate, then optimize
points: Builds first, measures the outcome, then improves it.
Work guided by evidence rather than assumptions.
Examples: algorithm optimization, AI token optimization, software architecture refinement, data-driven LinkedIn experiments.

differentiators.title: Bridge business and technology
points: Translates business requirements into technical solutions.
Considers maintainability, scalability, stakeholder needs and business value — not just implementation.

differentiators.title: Systems thinking
points: Prefers understanding how an entire system works and how its components interact.

differentiators.title: Continuous learning
points: Deliberately explores unfamiliar technologies and underlying concepts instead of staying in one stack.
Focuses on principles that transfer across tools and frameworks.

differentiators.title: Optimization mindset
points: Enjoys improving performance, architecture, workflows, learning processes and engineering practices.
Optimization is a recurring pattern across her projects.

differentiators.title: Build before claiming expertise
points: Demonstrates competence through projects and practical work rather than broad claims about expertise.

differentiators.title: Intellectual honesty
points: Comfortable changing her opinion when new evidence appears.
Communicates uncertainty honestly while actively working toward understanding.

differentiators.title: AI as an engineering tool
points: Uses AI to support reasoning, architecture, experimentation and productivity — not as a substitute for engineering judgment.

differentiators.title: Ownership
points: Interests naturally extend toward architecture, communication, leadership, requirements engineering and long-term product thinking.

professional_profile.core_differentiator_narrative: Her strongest differentiator is not a specific programming language or framework. It is her habit of understanding complete systems, measuring outcomes, making thoughtful engineering decisions, and continuously improving solutions.
professional_profile.engineering_philosophy_quote: The projects I enjoy most are the ones where I can understand a system end-to-end, make thoughtful architectural decisions, measure the results, and iteratively improve the solution. That is the way I like to work, whether I am building backend software, designing AI workflows, or collaborating with stakeholders.
personal_positioning: Software Engineer with Architecture and AI Focus.
Engineer who enjoys understanding complex systems and making them better.
Someone who values thoughtful engineering, continuous learning and measurable improvement.
four_questions_every_application_answers: What kinds of problems do I enjoy solving?
How do I approach unfamiliar technologies?
What evidence demonstrates how I work?
Why does that make me valuable for this specific role?
